profile.Name: Lorraine
profile.Job: Disciple of Narko who longs to see the world
profile.Personality: Restless and devout. She praises Narko, calls Holy Nation land the land of the heretics, and will no longer let the Holy Nation keep her in hiding.
profile.Backstory: She lives in Narko's Refuge, the Disciples' secret city behind a wall of acid rain in the Iron Valleys. She came for safety in numbers, shelter from harassment, and a cause bigger than herself, and has stayed so long she has forgotten what the sun looks like. She wants the Holy Nation dealt with.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Trails off her sentences and calls strangers "outlander". Jokes about the acid, as in "Got to love that acid smell...", and wishes Narko's shadow upon her enemies.
